ideal: Alert on NVIDIA's 8-K: it is exactly the material news she asked for (new material agreement + material financial obligation), described in plain words, with the link. Silence is wrong here.

Alerts, translates the filing type into plain words, accurately restates the three items from the evidence, stays short, links it. Nothing invented.
verdicts.answer: NVIDIA filed an 8-K (current-events report) disclosing a material agreement, a new material financial obligation, and a Regulation FD disclosure. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000069/nvda-20260817.htm
